entry.title: Daemon 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes to Daemon or Daemon Listen. Each plugin has two zips: `*-mpc-armv7.zip` for Gen1 MPCs and the Force, `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` for Gen2 (MPC OS 3.x, tested offline only). Your `daemon.conf` and the engine folder are kept on upgrade.
